description.en: The AccessKey ID of the cloud account.
The ID of the cloud account.

The binding ID. Call the [ListBindAccount](https://api.aliyun-inc.com/#/publishment/document/cloud-siem/863fdf54478f4cc5877e27c2a5fe9e44?tenantUuid=f382fccd88b94c5c8c864def6815b854\&activeTabKey=api%7CListBindAccount) operation to obtain the binding ID.

description.zh:
多云的code。取值：
- qcloud：腾讯云。
- aliyun：阿里云。
- hcloud：华为云
description.en:
The code for the cloud service provider. Valid values:

- qcloud: Tencent Cloud

- aliyun: Alibaba Cloud

- hcloud: Huawei Cloud

description.zh:
威胁分析的数据管理中心所在地。您需要根据资产所在地域，选择管理中心所在地。取值：
- cn-hangzhou：资产属于中国内地与中国香港
- ap-southeast-1：资产属于海外地域
description.en:
The region where the threat analysis data center is located. Select a region based on the location of your assets. Valid values:

- cn-hangzhou: Your assets are in mainland China or the China (Hong Kong) region.

- ap-southeast-1: Your assets are in regions outside China.

description.zh: 管理员切换成其他成员视角的用户ID。
description.en: The user ID of the member. An administrator can specify this parameter to perform the operation from the perspective of a member.

description.zh:
视图类型。

- 0：当前阿里云账号视图。
- 1：企业下所有账号的视图。
description.en:
The type of the view. Valid values:

- 0: The view of the current Alibaba Cloud account.

- 1: The view of all accounts that are managed by your enterprise.

title.zh: 删除已经绑定的多云账号

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cloud-siem delete-bind-account --bind-id 10 --account-id 123xxxxxxx --access-id ABCXXXXXXXX --cloud-code hcloud --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --role-type 1 --role-for 1130916744880000 --api-version 2022-06-16 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cloud-siem DeleteBindAccount --region cn-hangzhou --CloudCode hcloud --BindId 10 --AccountId 123xxxxxxx --AccessId ABCXXXXXXXX --RoleType 1 --RoleFor 1130916744880000 --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
